items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Schillings' in the context of a book of arrangements, but does not describe a personal or professional relationship with the person/entity.

ctx.x: And he had turned out to be a great arranger and a guitar player.
That was the days when they brought -- This is the year when the Schillings came out. The Schillings book of arrangements. You know, the new book that came out on the Schillings, arranging?
